title: whatsapp_inbox._link_fulfilled
description: The payload of `appointments.booking_request.fulfilled`, verbatim. A manifest listener has no mapping layer — the relay hands the event payload straight to the command — so this schema is not free to describe a shape of its own, and `additionalProperties` stays TRUE because the runtime stamps every event payload with its system params (`hub_id`, `now`, `new_id`, the business identity…). Anything stricter dead-letters every booking answer, which is the silent failure appointments#38 exists to remove.

request_id.description: The request that was approved. It is the correlation of the whole hand-over: it travelled out in `whatsapp_inbox.request.approved` and comes back untouched.

appointment_id.description: The object that now exists. Stored as `linked_object_id`, which is what lets the inbox open the booking it produced.

module.description: Who booked it (`appointments`). Stored as `linked_module` so the answer is not hard-wired to one module: a table reservation would answer the same way.
